panel_description_zh: 中景平视，李斌坐在沙发上手机屏幕朝上；屏幕亮着显示'老婆 来电'（绿色横幅）；李斌目光望向手机（向下）；表情无语；手边有外卖盒（已开吃）；背景客厅沙发一角。
prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot of a 30-something East Asian Chinese man sitting on the grey fabric sofa with his black smartphone in matte-black case lying on his knee with the screen facing up. The phone screen is glowing and shows a Chinese incoming call interface with the caller name in large characters, a green accept button at the bottom, the time at the top. The man's eyes are half-lidded looking down at the phone, eyebrows flat, lips pressed together, dark circles under his eyes, clean-shaven jaw with no stubble, short black slightly messy side-swept hair. Wearing a loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt and navy blue plaid pajama pants. An opened takeout food container sits beside him on the sofa or a small table. Warm white living room light plus the cool phone screen light reflecting on his face. Mood: the silent before the call, the brief still before the storm of the wife's voice returns. Text watermark 'P10-PN01' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, smiling, wife visible in frame, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, romantic soft lighting, exaggerated cartoonish sweat drops
